verdict.rationale: Convex documents ACID transactions (convex-docs-12) and optional schema validation (convex-docs-3), but as a document/NoSQL-style database its query API is plain TypeScript code — there is no evidence of a declarative join operator or enforced foreign-key/referential constraints; developers typically fetch related documents manually in code. Missing for 10: explicit join syntax/support, declarative relational constraints (foreign keys), and any documentation or example showing multi-table join queries.
